reasons: Lake identity is verified for Monroe v. Pape, decided 1961-02-20 by the U.S. Supreme Court, cluster_id 106170.
Lake citations list 365 U.S. 167, 81 S. Ct. 473, 5 L. Ed. 2d 492, and 1961 U.S. LEXIS 1687.
The treatment record does not make the authority wholly dead; it marks caution and says the municipal-liability point was overruled in part while the under-color holding remains good law.
residual_risks: Authority must not be presented as unrestricted good law because the disclosed treatment is caution/limited by point.

reasons: Lens B does not make support/home-role findings.
No disclosed treatment field or progeny edge defeats Monroe's currency as a § 1983 anchor so long as the limited/caution status is preserved.
residual_risks: Lens A may still review whether the home role is substantively apt.

reasons: Lens B does not review support or quote fidelity for the holding text.
The treatment scope note expressly preserves the core under-color state-law holding as good law while identifying the municipal-liability overrule.
residual_risks: Do not use this holding for Monroe's municipal-person rule without the Monell limitation.
Lens A may still test support and wording.

reasons: The payload matches the lake treatment fields: field_i_validity caution, as_of_treatment 2026-06-30, composite_basis migration-seed, and varies_by_point true.
The lake scope note matches the page: overruled in part by Monell as to municipal liability; under-color holding remains good law.
The disclosed progeny edges include negative treatment, but the asserted caution/point-varying treatment accounts for that rather than claiming clean good law.
residual_risks: Lake derivation marks some treatment lanes audit_needed and cap_hit, so the disclosed record supports caution rather than a stronger clean-law label.

reasons: Lake identity identifies the court as U.S. Supreme Court with court_level scotus.
The weight label Binding — SCOTUS is consistent with source-court weight; the separate caution treatment handles later limitation.
residual_risks: Readers could overread binding weight as clean validity unless displayed with the caution/limited treatment badge.

reasons: The lake point_overrides entry uses point legacy-limited-monroe-v-pape, field_i_validity caution, s3_binding_status provisional, and Monell, cluster_id 109881, cite 436 U.S. 658, field_ii limited.
The same treatment scope note explains the limitation as Monell overruling Monroe in part on municipal liability while leaving the under-color holding good.
A separate Monell edge is labeled overruled, but the page text discloses overruled-in-part treatment, so the legacy limited override is not contradicted as framed.
residual_risks: The disclosed Monell labels are not fully normalized across edges: one says limited and another says overruled.
reviewed.suggested_tightening: Consider rendering the Monell point as overruled in part / limited to harmonize the duplicate edge labels.
